images.title: A column of three dates
images.purpose: Shows a new calendar shape, three dates one below the other, written as a, a + 7 and a + 14, with sum 3a + 21.
images.composition: Two short columns of cells side by side in the centre, numbers on the left and letters on the right, one equation below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, generous empty margins, the main object large and centred. Left: one vertical column of three touching square cells with teal (#0072B2) outlines holding 10, 17 and 24 from top to bottom. Right, with a clear gap: one vertical column of three touching square cells with amber (#E69F00) outlines holding a, a + 7 and a + 14 from top to bottom, each level with the matching number cell. Below both columns, centred, the equation 3a + 21 = 51 in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Exactly 6 cells; no calendar page, no weekday names, no arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Below is seven more, so any shape can be written with one letter.
